verdict.label: Full review
verdict.summary: Microsoft Entra ID requires bringing your own custom OAuth app as Composio does not provide a managed app.

composioFit.summary: Composio requires a custom auth config and your own Microsoft Entra ID OAuth app credentials since no managed app is available.
whyOwnApp: Composio-managed OAuth is not available for Microsoft Entra ID.
Requires your own client ID and client secret.

phases.name: Create Composio Auth Config
steps: Go to the Composio dashboard auth configs page.
Click Create Auth Config for Microsoft Entra ID.
phases.handoff: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard to use in the Microsoft Entra ID portal.

phases.name: Register App in Microsoft Portal
steps: Register an application in the Microsoft developer portal.
Add the redirect URI provided by Composio.
Generate and copy the Client ID and Client Secret.
phases.handoff: Paste the Client ID and Client Secret back into the Composio dashboard.

artefacts.title: Microsoft Entra ID App Registration Values
artefacts.body:
App Name: AI Agent Integration
Redirect URI: <Composio callback URL from your auth config>

requirements.label: Custom App Credentials
requirements.when: Always required for Microsoft Entra ID toolkit

redirectRules.rule: Must match the redirect URI generated by Composio in the auth config dashboard.

blockers.symptom: Authentication fails due to missing or incorrect client ID and secret.
blockers.cause: The Microsoft Entra ID app credentials were not correctly copied back into Composio.
blockers.fix: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the Microsoft developer portal into the Composio dashboard auth config.
blockers.fallback: Recreate the app registration in Microsoft Entra ID and update the Composio auth config.

checklist.text: Navigate to the Composio dashboard auth configs page.
Create an auth config for Microsoft Entra ID and copy the redirect URI.
Register your application in the Microsoft developer portal using the redirect URI.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from Microsoft and save them in Composio.

uncertainties: Specific tenant type requirements (single-tenant vs multi-tenant) for the Microsoft Entra ID app registration could not be verified from available evidence.
Exact scope strings and verification processes enforced by Microsoft Entra ID are not documented in the provided sources.

claims.text: Composio-managed OAuth available for MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID is No, requiring a custom auth config and bring-your-own OAuth app.
For OAuth toolkits, register an app in the provider's developer portal and add the redirect URI from the dashboard. Then copy the Client ID and Client Secret back into Composio.
claims.quote: For OAuth toolkits, register an app in the provider's developer portal and add the redirect URI from the dashboard. Then copy the Client ID and Client Secret back into Composio.
